summary: CareDx, Inc. (CDNA) filed an 8-K announcing its acquisition of Naveris, Inc. via a merger of wholly owned subsidiary Nautilus Merger Sub with Naveris. CareDx will pay $160 million in cash at closing, subject to customary adjustments for cash, debt, expenses, and net working capital, plus up to $100 million in contingent earn-out payments based on revenue milestones for fiscal years 2026 and 2027. A $5 million escrow covers post-closing adjustments. Closing conditions include HSR antitrust clearance, accuracy of representations, performance of covenants, and absence of a material adverse effect on Naveris. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and revenue milestone achievement risk.
